annotation.bound_parties_text: Member States must only accept approvals granted under UN Regulations No 140 and No 141 for EC type-approval of new vehicle types; vehicle manufacturers are subject to the amended type-approval requirements.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Member States shall only accept approvals granted under UN Regulation No 140.
annotation.dates_quote: With effect from 24 April 2019, for the purposes of EC type-approval of new vehicle types with regard to their electronic stability control systems
